  ╔═ STAR/AMP / COMMAND GUIDE ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗  
  ║Find: Search commands, shortcuts, gestures…                                                   ║  
  ║‹ All commands ›   111 results   · Tab changes category                                       ║  
  ║  player: volume 5%                                                           wheel over VOL  ║  
  ║  player: next visualization                                                  click analyzer  ║  
  ║  player: play or pause                                                          right click  ║  
  ║  equalizer: enable or bypass                                                    click [ON ]  ║  
  ║  equalizer: change preset                                                click the chevrons  ║  
  ║  equalizer: select it                                                        click a filter  ║  
  ║  equalizer: previous / next filter                                     wheel over the panel  ║  
  ║  album: open full image                                                         click cover  ║  
  ║  album: previous / next art                                                     click < / >  ║  
  ║  album: open music database                                            click title / artist  ║  
  ║  overlays: close the picker                                                   click outside  ║  
  ║  overlays: close a panel                                                      click `close`  ║  
  ║  overlays: what that panel controls                                        click `settings`  ║  
  ║  Edit filter frequency, gain and width                                                       ║  
  ║  Reorder or duplicate EQ stages                                                              ║  
  ║  Import or export an EQ profile                                                              ║  
  ║  Show your current track in Discord                                                          ║  
  ║  Set SSH audio compatibility                                                                 ║  
  ║  Manage equalizer profiles                                                                   ║  
  ║  Open panel settings                                                         Click Settings  ║  
  ║  Configure Last.fm and ListenBrainz                                                          ║  
  ║  Create a Gravity Queue                                                       Click Gravity  ║  
  ║  Open track actions                                                       Right-click track  ║  
  ║  Switch graphical and terminal presentation                                              F9  ║  
  ║  Refresh missing graphics                                                            Ctrl+L  ║  
  ║  Collapse or expand a graphical panel                                    Panel fold control  ║  
  ║  Play a remote library over SSH                                                              ║  
  ║  Index a music folder                                                                        ║  
  ║› Read shortcut notation                                                                      ║  
  ║                                                                                              ║  
  ║Read shortcut notation                                                                        ║  
  ║Understand case-sensitive and panel-specific keys.                                            ║  
  ║                                                                                              ║  
  ║Lowercase letters are unmodified keys; uppercase letters mean Shift. For example L loads the  ║  
  ║whole library while l opens its browser. A key in the Equalizer, Album or Library can override║  
  ║the same key in Player. Focus shortcuts are Alt+1…5. Help consumes all typing until closed.   ║  
  ║                                                                                              ║
